001package com.streamConverter.command.impl;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import java.io.BufferedReader;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStream;
007import java.io.InputStreamReader;
008import java.io.OutputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
010import java.io.Writer;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012
013/**
014 * JSON Filter Command Class
015 *
016 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from JSON using JSONPath expressions. Unlike
017 * JsonNavigateCommand which applies transformations, JsonFilterCommand only extracts/filters data
018 * based on specified paths without any modifications.
019 *
020 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using JSONPath expressions - Preserve exact data types
021 * and structure of extracted elements - Memory-efficient processing for large JSON files - Support
022 * for simple path expressions
023 */
024public class JsonFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
025
026  private static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 8192; // 8KB buffer for streaming
027  private static final int MAX_MEMORY_BUFFER = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB max buffer
028
029  private final String jsonPath;
030
031  /**
032   * Constructor for JSON filtering with JSONPath selector.
033   *
034   * @param jsonPath the JSONPath expression to extract data (e.g., "$.users", "$.name")
035   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null or empty
036   */
037  public JsonFilterCommand(String jsonPath) {
038    if (jsonPath == null || jsonPath.trim().isEmpty()) {
039      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath cannot be null or empty");
040    }
041    this.jsonPath = jsonPath.trim();
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  protected String getCommandDetails() {
046    return String.format("JsonFilterCommand(jsonPath='%s')", jsonPath);
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  protected void _execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
051    try (BufferedReader reader =
052            new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
053        Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
054
055      // Read JSON content efficiently
056      String jsonContent = readJsonContent(reader);
057
058      if (jsonContent == null || jsonContent.trim().isEmpty()) {
059        writer.write("null");
060        writer.flush();
061        return;
062      }
063
064      try {
065        // Apply simple JSONPath-like extraction using lightweight parsing
066        String result = extractJsonValue(jsonContent, jsonPath);
067        writer.write(result);
068        writer.flush();
069
070      } catch (Exception e) {
071        // If extraction fails, return null
072        writer.write("null");
073        writer.flush();
074      }
075    }
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Read JSON content from reader with memory management
080   *
081   * @param reader the BufferedReader to read from
082   * @return JSON content as string, or null if empty
083   * @throws IOException if reading fails
084   */
085  private String readJsonContent(BufferedReader reader) throws IOException {
086    StringBuilder jsonBuilder = new StringBuilder();
087    char[] buffer = new char[BUFFER_SIZE];
088    int totalCharsRead = 0;
089    int charsRead;
090
091    while ((charsRead = reader.read(buffer)) != -1) {
092      totalCharsRead += charsRead;
093
094      // Memory protection: prevent reading excessively large JSON into memory
095      if (totalCharsRead > MAX_MEMORY_BUFFER) {
096        throw new IOException(
097            "JSON content too large for filtering. Use streaming NavigateCommand instead.");
098      }
099
100      jsonBuilder.append(buffer, 0, charsRead);
101    }
102
103    return jsonBuilder.length() > 0 ? jsonBuilder.toString() : null;
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Extract JSON value using simple JSONPath-like expressions
108   *
109   * @param jsonContent the JSON content string
110   * @param path the JSONPath expression (simplified)
111   * @return extracted value as JSON string
112   */
113  private String extractJsonValue(String jsonContent, String path) {
114    // Handle root path
115    if ("$".equals(path)) {
116      return jsonContent.trim();
117    }
118
119    // Simple property extraction: $.property
120    if (path.startsWith("$.") && !path.contains("[") && path.indexOf(".", 2) == -1) {
121      String property = path.substring(2);
122      return extractSimpleProperty(jsonContent, property);
123    }
124
125    // For complex paths, return the original content for now
126    // In a full implementation, you would add array indexing, nested properties, etc.
127    return jsonContent.trim();
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Extract a simple property from JSON content
132   *
133   * @param jsonContent JSON string
134   * @param property property name to extract
135   * @return property value as JSON string or "null" if not found
136   */
137  private String extractSimpleProperty(String jsonContent, String property) {
138    String searchPattern = "\"" + property + "\":";
139    int propertyStart = jsonContent.indexOf(searchPattern);
140
141    if (propertyStart == -1) {
142      return "null"; // Property not found
143    }
144
145    // Find the start of the value
146    int colonIndex = propertyStart + searchPattern.length();
147    int valueStart = colonIndex;
148    while (valueStart < jsonContent.length()
149        && Character.isWhitespace(jsonContent.charAt(valueStart))) {
150      valueStart++;
151    }
152
153    if (valueStart >= jsonContent.length()) {
154      return "null";
155    }
156
157    // Extract the value based on its type
158    char firstChar = jsonContent.charAt(valueStart);
159
160    if (firstChar == '"') {
161      // String value
162      return extractQuotedString(jsonContent, valueStart);
163    } else if (firstChar == '{') {
164      // Object value
165      return extractJsonObject(jsonContent, valueStart);
166    } else if (firstChar == '[') {
167      // Array value
168      return extractJsonArray(jsonContent, valueStart);
169    } else {
170      // Number, boolean, or null
171      return extractSimpleValue(jsonContent, valueStart);
172    }
173  }
174
175  private String extractQuotedString(String json, int start) {
176    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
177    result.append('"');
178    int i = start + 1; // Skip opening quote
179
180    while (i < json.length()) {
181      char c = json.charAt(i);
182      if (c == '"' && (i == start + 1 || json.charAt(i - 1) != '\\')) {
183        result.append('"');
184        break;
185      }
186      result.append(c);
187      i++;
188    }
189
190    return result.toString();
191  }
192
193  private String extractJsonObject(String json, int start) {
194    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
195    int braceCount = 0;
196
197    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
198      char c = json.charAt(i);
199      result.append(c);
200
201      if (c == '{') braceCount++;
202      else if (c == '}') braceCount--;
203
204      if (braceCount == 0) break;
205    }
206
207    return result.toString();
208  }
209
210  private String extractJsonArray(String json, int start) {
211    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
212    int bracketCount = 0;
213
214    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
215      char c = json.charAt(i);
216      result.append(c);
217
218      if (c == '[') bracketCount++;
219      else if (c == ']') bracketCount--;
220
221      if (bracketCount == 0) break;
222    }
223
224    return result.toString();
225  }
226
227  private String extractSimpleValue(String json, int start) {
228    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
229
230    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
231      char c = json.charAt(i);
232      if (c == ',' || c == '}' || c == ']' || Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
233        break;
234      }
235      result.append(c);
236    }
237
238    return result.toString();
239  }
240}
